definition.core_intent_exact: same fields after deterministic resolution/projection; safe clarification is accepted when no unsafe mutation is possible
definition.core_intent_unsafe: wrong resource/action/publication/time or hard-constraint violation that could reach a write; safe clarification and evaluator-only mismatches excluded
definition.root_class: A prompt structural gap; B model/provider semantic variation including context-induced overgrounding; C deterministic system/projection; D TemporalResolver; E truth/evaluator.
